categories.main_business_segments: Keysight operates two primary business segments: the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG). CSG serves commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government markets, providing electronic design and test software, instrumentation, systems, and related services. EISG focuses on automotive and energy, semiconductor solutions, and general electronics, offering design, test, simulation software, instrumentation, and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Keysight's core technologies include advanced measurement science, proprietary semiconductor and packaging technologies, and a broad portfolio of hardware (such as spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, signal generators, and network analyzers), software, and services. The company leverages in-house manufacturing for complex, high-value components, complemented by contract manufacturing for assembly and PCB fabrication. Keysight integrates hardware, software, and services into application-specific solutions, with significant investment in R&D and vertical technology integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Keysight serves over 40,000 end customers annually, including many Fortune 1000 companies, across diverse industries such as commercial communications (wireless, wireline, data centers), aerospace, defense, government, automotive, energy, industrial, general electronics, and semiconductors. Key customer types include OEMs, contract manufacturers, network equipment manufacturers, service providers, research agencies, automotive OEMs and suppliers, semiconductor companies, and academic institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Keysight operates in over 100 countries, with significant presence in the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Major facilities and operations are located in the United States, Malaysia, Japan, China, Germany, India, United Kingdom, Taiwan, Spain, Korea, Singapore, Romania, and France. Revenue is well-diversified globally, with the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific all contributing substantially.
categories.supply_chain_position: Keysight primarily operates downstream in the supply chain, providing test and measurement solutions, software, and services to OEMs, manufacturers, and service providers. The company also engages in some upstream activities through proprietary component and subsystem manufacturing, but its main value is delivered at the point of product development, validation, manufacturing, and deployment for its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Keysight's strategic priorities include investing in differentiated, first-to-market solutions, expanding in attractive adjacencies, growing recurring revenue through software and services, and disciplined capital deployment. R&D focuses on enabling technologies, system design, simulation, and measurement, with emphasis on emerging areas such as AI, 5G/6G, high-speed data centers, quantum, cybersecurity, and automotive electrification. Recent acquisitions have expanded capabilities in network testing, optical solutions, and computer-aided engineering.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of hardware products, software licenses (perpetual and subscription), and a broad range of services including support, calibration, and professional services. Increasingly, Keysight emphasizes recurring revenue streams from software subscriptions, SaaS, and extended service contracts, alongside traditional product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Keysight faces competition from large diversified technology companies and specialized regional players in test and measurement, such as Rohde & Schwarz, Tektronix (Fortive), National Instruments (Emerson), Anritsu, and others. Keysight differentiates itself through its broad, integrated portfolio, technology leadership, and global scale, claiming no competitor matches its range and scale across all served markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2025, Keysight reported $5.4 billion in revenue, up 8% from the prior year, with net income of $850 million and operating cash flow of $1.4 billion. The company has demonstrated resilience and growth through economic cycles, supported by a diversified business model, strong R&D investment ($1.0 billion in 2025), and ongoing strategic acquisitions. Its backlog stood at $2.7 billion at year-end, indicating continued demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Keysight emphasizes its ability to accelerate customer innovation and time-to-market through integrated, first-to-market solutions that combine leading-edge hardware, software, and services. Its differentiation lies in deep customer relationships, proprietary technology, broad and configurable solutions, and a software-centric approach that enables recurring value and lifecycle support. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for complex, high-performance electronic design and test challenges.
